title: Brand Guidelines
summary: House visual identity rules, including the exact logo file to place in generated assets.

bindings.title: Brand Voice
appliesWhen: Writing user-facing copy: marketing pages, emails, error messages
doesNotApplyWhen: Internal code comments or commit messages
bindings.instructions: Write in plain, direct language. Name things by what a customer recognizes, not internal system terms. Prefer active voice.
constraints: Do not use exclamation points in error messages.

bindings.title: Logo Placement
appliesWhen: Adding a header, footer, or splash screen to a generated page or document
doesNotApplyWhen: Internal admin tooling with no customer-facing chrome
bindings.instructions: Always use the exact logo file below — never redraw or approximate it. Place it bottom-right at a fixed 32px height, with at least 16px of clear space on every side.
constraints: Do not recolor, stretch, or rotate the logo file.
verification: The placed image is byte-identical to the attached logo asset.
